name: Mochins
description: Mochins is a 4,000-piece collection of looping soft-3D mochi PFP GIFs on Shape. Each mochi is stacked from six layers — stage, haze, dough, face, topping, and steam — then flattened onto one 16-frame GIF. Studio light. Volume. Specular. Contact shadow. No outlines. The dough squashes. Steam rises.
